decisions: Both cuts are taken. item_stat_block alone leaves stats.py near 482 of 500, an 18-line margin any later feature in the fold would reopen; champion_growth takes get_champion_base_stats to the stat-formula layer it belongs to and lands the residue at 427.

data_registry.py's memo table keys the two item-stat memos by the string calculator.stats._ITEM_STATS_MEMO and calculator.stats._ITEM_STATS_VALIDATION_MEMO. The tool does not rewrite strings; repay both in the same commit.
